blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Union of Journalists of the Philippines (NUJP) condemned what it described as “use of violence” against a reporter of the alternative media outlet Bulatlat, who was present in the farmers-led protest in Quezon City on Monday, Oct. 19. Identified by the NUJP as Ernest Cruz, the reporter was one of the media workers who covered the protest that was held at the central office of the Department of Agrarian Reform, but the police “use[d] force in an attempt to restrain [him].” The NUJP said a campus journalist from the Far Eastern University and Tudla correspondent, identified […]...
